name: shrmha.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: shrmha.com scores 71 out of 100 (C). 6 checks fail now, 24 are at risk, and 30 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 20 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /?cat=1, /?tag=%d9%85%d8%b5%d8%b1%d9%8a%d8%a9, /?tag=%d9%85%d9%8a%d9%84%d9%81 and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 165 elements on /, /?cat=1, /?tag=%d9%85%d8%b5%d8%b1%d9%8a%d8%a9, for example a[data-id="https://shrmha.com/"] > strong and #block-72 > .wp-block-paragraph > a[href$="sokoosoko.com/"][data-id="https://sokoosoko.com/"][data-type="link"]…
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /?cat=1, /?tag=%d9%85%d8%b5%d8%b1%d9%8a%d8%a9, for example .btn. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 48 elements on /, /?cat=1, /?tag=%d9%85%d8%b5%d8%b1%d9%8a%d8%a9, for example .preview-date > a[href="https://shrmha.com/?p=8052"] and .preview-date > a[href="https://shrmha.com/?p=8049"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

Front-end libraries have no known flaw
